artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
16 Different Flavours of Hell" is a 1993 compilation album by Pop Will Eat Itself, released on the RCA label. The album spans 19 tracks and runs for approximately 78 minutes, showcasing the band's blend of electronic and rock styles that defined their sound in the late 1980s and early 1990s. It serves as a retrospective collection highlighting the band's innovative fusion of hip-hop, dance, and rock elements, which positioned them as pioneers in alternative electronic rock music.

This compilation occupies a significant place in Pop Will Eat Itself's discography as it captures the evolution of their sound up to that point, including material from their earlier albums and singles. Although it did not achieve major commercial success, peaking at number 73 on the UK Albums Chart, it remains an important document of the band's creative output during their peak years. The album reflects the band's experimental approach and their role in bridging genres, contributing to their cult status within the alternative music scene.
